title: Returned Payments in FlexLine Credit Reviews
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — in a credit review, the return cut is added to the review cut by the payments returned on the line in the last 12 months: two or more add 0.10; exactly one adds 0.05; none adds nothing.

- The review cut is the share of the credit limit a review takes off; the return cut is added to it as a share of the limit (0.10 is 10 percentage points).
- The payments counted are the returned-payment entries on the line, whatever their return code.
- The last 12 months are the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the review date.

## Questions answered

**One payment was returned 11 months before the review and another 13 months before. What is added?** 0.05; only the first is in the window.

**For a review on 4 November, does a return dated 4 November of the year before count?** No; a return dated 5 November of the year before does.

**Does a returned-payment fee count as a return?** No; the count is of returned payments.
